snippet.title: Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun | PS5 Version Out Now!
snippet.description:
EU: https://store.playstation.com/product/EP8923-PPSA30363_00-SHADOWTACTICSEU5
NA: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP1440-PPSA30364_00-SHADOWTACTICSNA5
The stealth tactics hit "Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun", now on PS5 with improved performance and loading times. Owners of the PS4 version get the upgrade for free!

Shadow Tactics is a hardcore tactical stealth game set in Japan around the Edo period. A new Shogun seizes power over Japan and enforces nationwide peace. In his battle against conspiracy and rebellion, he recruits five specialists with extraordinary skills for assassination, sabotage and espionage.
